title: Masayoshi Son 2000 yilda Alibaba'ga 20 million dollar tikkan
hook: Masayoshi Son 2000 yilda Alibaba'ga 20 million dollar tikkan.

scenes.text: 2000 yilda yapon investori Masayoshi Son kichik Alibaba kompaniyasiga 20 million dollar kiritdi.
U Jek Ma bilan bir necha daqiqalik suhbatdan keyin qaror qildi, deb aytiladi.
scenes.keywords: two businessmen talking in meeting room

scenes.text: Son keyinroq aytishicha, u biznes rejaga emas, asoschining o'ziga ishongan.
2014 yilda, Alibaba birjaga chiqishi arafasida, SoftBank ulushi taxminan 58 milliard dollarga baholangan.

description:
2000 yilda Masayoshi Son boshchiligidagi SoftBank Jek Ma asos solgan Alibaba'ga taxminan 20 million dollar kiritdi. 2014 yilda Alibaba birjaga chiqishi arafasida, Bloomberg hisob-kitoblariga ko'ra, bu ulush taxminan 58 milliard dollarga baholangan edi.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-12 (web search). Reuters: Son put in 2 billion yen (about $20M) in 2000 after a short meeting with Ma (accounts say about five minutes, so 'bir necha daqiqalik ... deb aytiladi' stays hedged; one encyclopedia-style source dates the deal to 1999, most say 2000). FIXED: the $58bn figure is a Bloomberg estimate from May 2014 (consensus analyst valuations of Alibaba at about $168bn, SoftBank stake about 34%), i.e. before the IPO, not an IPO-day value; other 2014 estimates ranged from about $50bn to $75bn. Scene 4 now says 'birjaga chiqishi arafasida ... baholangan'. The 'business plan' remark is Son's own later account, so scene 3 is attributed with 'aytishicha'. Sources: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2014-05-07/softbanks-58-billion-payday-on-its-alibaba-investment ; https://www.cnbc.com/2014/08/27/mega-ipo-to-rekindle-the-bromance-behind-alibabas-rise.html ; https://amp.scmp.com/tech/article/3249933/japans-softbank-concludes-run-alibabas-biggest-shareholder-drawing-close-one-most-successful
